title: Yuu Camp Aura
description: Campfire aura regeneration with per-player toggle.
body:
# Yuu Camp Aura

Campfire aura regeneration with per-player toggle.

## Features
- Lit campfires grant regeneration in a configurable radius.
- Per-player enable/disable so users can opt out anytime.
- Action bar indicator when aura is active.
- Lightweight scheduled checks with editable values in config.yml.

## Command
- `/campaura [status|on|off]`

## Permission
- `yuucampaura.use`

## Compatibility
- Loaders: spigot, paper, purpur
- Game versions: 1.16.5, 1.17.1, 1.18.2, 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.1

## Notes
- Lightweight implementation with configurable behavior in `config.yml`.
- Built by **yuutaxd**.
